example.title: F.L. Hawkins Tenant Farmstead, Silo (HABS TX-3384-F)

brief: Plain 1920s concrete stave silo about 14 ft across and 45 ft high, its light-grey staves laid in a neat brick-like grid with closely spaced steel hoop bands and small hoop lugs, open at the top with no roof or chute left. A narrow unpainted plank lean-to shed stands at its base, and an overgrown fence row of volunteer trees and a weathered frame barn crowd in behind; the mown hay meadow comes right up to it.
